A few useful answers

Can I play offline?+

Yes. After downloading, no internet connection or account is required.

Can I switch the interface language?+

Simplified Chinese commands and compact English subtitles appear simultaneously. There is no language-switching mode.

Are there ads or in-app purchases?+

No. The current store description states there are no ads, in-app purchases, or personal-data collection.

Data & privacy

No account, ads, in-app purchases, or personal-data collection. Play offline after download.

Read the App Store description

You are one drop of water.
Your enemy is a fleet that spans worlds.

V-Type is a portrait sci-fi action game about momentum, annihilation, and a breach that lasts only an instant.

Drag anywhere to send the droplet gliding across the battlefield. Read enemy formations and beam warnings. Destroy every target, then tap the opening before it closes. Break through fighter armor, descend into cityships, and cross from the scale of machines to the scale of planets.

ONE DROPLET. MANY SCALES.
• One-thumb relative drag controls
• Continuous battles from outer hull to interior
• Full-path warning lines for focused beam attacks
• Tactical retreat: fall back one scale and recover ENERGY
• Three escalating cycles and a shape-shifting final machine guardian
• Light and sound synchronized at 128 BPM

DRAG. TAP. BREACH.
Drag to move. Tap the target when the breach opens. Hold at the top of the screen to retreat. The rules are compact; mastering the momentum is not.

A SCI-FI INTERFACE WITH ITS OWN VISUAL LANGUAGE
V-Type displays Simplified Chinese commands with compact English subtitles at the same time. It is a deliberate part of the game's otherworldly identity, not a language setting you have to manage.

No account. No ads. No in-app purchases. No personal-data collection. Play offline after download.
